_doc: PRIOR ART: volumes.mjs (per books.language volumes, no page-kind or cell dimension) — this adds the one cell it cannot see: Tibetan multi-leaf photos (EAP pecha frames, two or more leaves per served page), measured read-only on 2026-10-25 over the 1,406 live Tibetan books that hold #6948 frame pages (scripts/eval/split-leaf-5771/, job split-leaves-5771, #5771). planner_v0.py does not read this file yet: a cell decision needs a code change (its Tibetan entries are the whole-language correction loop and translation). Counts are pages with page_number > 0.

arms.seam: the stored Yigdzin read as served (a whole-page read, or leaf reads joined at <leaf-break/>)
arms.cut: the stored read cut onto leaves at <leaf-break/> or the ledger's line counts; no re-OCR, $0
arms.reread: each leaf crop re-read alone with Yigdzin 1 (vLLM, gex45); Yigdzin 1 split-leaf reread (GPU) in ocr/route-costs.json
